acceptance: A lane build that adds a test matching on err.Error() text in a package with no baseline row is refused at the build floor with the testaudit finding (a test through the real floor entry point, red before the fix)
A lane build whose changed tests produce no new testaudit finding passes the floor unchanged
DefaultBuildFloorChecks lists the test-audit check (the same shape as TestDefaultBuildFloorChecks_IncludesPersonaBudgetCheck)
fix: Add a static floor check that runs the test-audit rules on the changed test packages against the tree baseline (testaudit.CheckTree scoped to the changed packages, or the `evolve test audit --check` verb) and refuses the handoff with each 'has no baseline row' finding. Reuse the persona-budget floor check as the pattern.
summary: StaticBuildFloorChecks and SuiteBuildFloorChecks (go/internal/core/build_floor_reviewer.go:28-51) run the tests of the changed packages and a fixed list of static checks. The test-audit tree ratchet (go/internal/testaudit, TestTreeRatchet, verb `evolve test audit --check`) is not in the floor. On 2026-11-19 cycle 2530 shipped internal/incidentkb TestRender_EmptyAndErrorBranches and cycle 2533 shipped acs/cycle2533 TestC2533_004 with an error-text-match finding and no baseline row. Main required CI was red from 08:01 (run 44484192548) and stayed red after 09:39 (run 44498432850). The console fix is PR console/main-red-testaudit-errtext. The same escape class was closed for persona budgets by personaBudgetFailures.
title: the build floor does not run the test-audit ratchet, so a lane ships a weak test that turns main red
